answer_1.quote: The VED generator (ii) takes a matched pair (I, Q) as input and outputs a new query Q_gen so that the pair (I, Q_gen) is mismatched while Q_gen stays lexically similar to Q. ... we develop a deep, end-to-end model that learns to identify mismatched query-item pairs and is also capable of generating mismatched queries given an item.
datasets: human-labeled query-item pairs (3.2M) and matched pairs from search logs (3M)
answer_1.outputs: synthetic mismatched queries (Q_gen) for given item titles

answer_2.quote: We used BLEU scores. ... In addition, we had human annotators to judge generated item-query pairs.

answer_4.quote: We had human annotators to judge generated item-query pairs. These annotators were trained to identify whether a generated pair is a match or a mismatch.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to decide if each generated query-item pair is a match or a mismatch.
